title: Oli-aligned faction rally supporting House dissolution in Kathmandu
reason: The contemporary report says the event was organized to express solidarity with Prime Minister Oli and his decision to dissolve the House, and that participants chanted in Oli’s favor. The manual excludes political rallies that support political positions associated with upcoming elections; the source reports election dates had been announced. It identifies no state-directed demand at this rally.
notes: Actual occurrence and organizer are confirmed by the opened Republica report. Attendance is not reported; the exclusion is based on the rally’s stated supportive purpose and lack of a state-directed demand, not on the crowd threshold.
